purpose: Extend the canonical Decision & Outcome Learning organ with a bounded owner-economic outcome review lane without creating execution authority or silently converting correlation into causation.

evidence.snapshotRule: Every review stores the exact SHA-256 of each canonical evidence file as observed at review time. Rebase/publish verification fails closed if those exact evidence bytes move before the review is published.

review.horizonRule: A horizon review may not be recorded before the decision reviewOnOrAfter boundary.
review.materialChangeRule: A material-change review may occur before the horizon only when the owner explicitly records the material-change trigger and exact evidence snapshot.

lessonPromotion.rule: One reviewed outcome may create a lesson candidate but cannot become a learned lesson. Learned lessons require repeated, directionally consistent reviewed outcomes across distinct decisions in the same experience class. Even then the lesson remains an observed association, not proof of causation.
